rules.statement: A bond executed before a Justice of the Peace for security of costs does not comply with the requirements of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 or the amending Ordinance Ho. 17 of 1852.
rules.supporting_quote: It does not therefore comply with the requirements of Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 or the amending Ordinance Ho. 17 of 1852 as regards the manner in which it was executed.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 or the amending Ordinance Ho. 17 of 1852
